statement_html:
Trouver des entiers relatifs \(u\) et \(v\) tels que :
37455 u + 256 v=1
Entrez votre réponse :
=
=
solution_html:
L'algorithme d'Euclide donne:
37455= \(146 \times \)256+79
\(256= 3 \times 79+\)19
\(79= 4 \times 19+\)3
\(19= 6 \times 3+1\)

On obtient les coefficients de Bezout en remontant l'algorithme:

\(1 =\)19\( - 6 \times \)3
\(1 =\)19\( - 6 \times \)(79\( -4 \times\) 19)\(=(1+6 \times 4)\) 19\( -6 \times\) 79
\(1= 25 \times \)19\( - 6 \times\) 79\(= 25 \times\)(256 \(-3 \times\) 79)\( -6 \times\) 79\(= 25 \times \)256\( - (25 \times 3 +6) \times\) 79
\(1= 25 \times \)256\(- 81 \times \)79\(= 25 \times\) 256\( - 81 \times\) (37455 \( - 146 \times \)256)\(= (25+ 81 \times 146) \times\) 256\( - 81 \times\) 37455
\(1= 11851 \times\) 256\( -81 \times\) 37455
